class.name: NNBTBlackboardErase
class.brief_description: Erases a key from the behaviour tree blackboard.
class.description: Erases [member key] from the effective [NNBlackboard] of the nearest [NNBTRoot] ancestor, including a key whose stored value is [code]null[/code]. Returns [code]SUCCESS[/code] when the key existed. Returns [code]FAILURE[/code] without an engine error when the key was absent. A missing [NNBTRoot] ancestor with a blackboard, or an empty [member key], is a configuration error that is reported once per node instance and returns [code]FAILURE[/code]. This leaf is fully data-driven: it is configured entirely by its properties, does not call and is not affected by an [code]on_tick[/code] override in an attached script, and works on the effective [NNBlackboard] of the nearest [NNBTRoot] ancestor through the [NoodleNodes] blackboard helpers.

members.member: The blackboard key to erase. Must be non-empty; an empty key reports an error once and returns [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE].
